required_candidate_semantics: UNCERTAIN outcome when the external world cannot be reconciled

current_head_inspection.interpretation: Authority hardening and effect recovery are orthogonal. The selected mainline can be strong against capability forgery while still lacking a generic contract for an external effect that succeeds before the worker loses the completion evidence.

whole_mesh_delta.candidate_spine: snapshot -> EffectIntent -> fresh dependency/capability revalidation -> opaque authority -> dispatch(effect_operation_id, semantic_fingerprint, recovery_class) -> external effect -> VERIFIED|UNCERTAIN outcome -> reconcile -> re-entry/causal credit

negative_result_lineage_gate_hypothesis.claim: A current implementation candidate should not be release-eligible unless every still-applicable durable negative result in its semantic dependency closure is either represented by a passing regression/receipt or explicitly marked NOT_APPLICABLE with evidence.
negative_result_lineage_gate_hypothesis.counterhypothesis: Normal code review and current-component tests are sufficient; explicit negative-result lineage adds bookkeeping without preventing material regressions.
negative_result_lineage_gate_hypothesis.falsifier: Across a controlled history of component replacements, ordinary tests catch all seeded semantic regressions with no worse detection latency or false-pass rate than the lineage gate while using materially less maintenance cost.

repo_native_probe.claim_limit: The probe/workflow are committed and executable; no CI execution result is claimed until the receipt exists and is reread.
